method: Prototype pass, no renames: every proposal repeats the CURRENT applied name (r3a functions.csv) with kind function and a signature. Scope: symbols_round1.json + symbols_round2.json entries of class hw1:* whose type was empty or applied degraded (r1/r2 cet_apply_report detail proto-applied-degraded); 2,245 in scope (1 renamed since, utyGameQuitToMain_2 -> cat_utyGameQuitToMainOrStats, skipped). Declaration source, in order: HomeworldSDL .c definition (named file, then any HomeworldSDL src file), the .h prototype, a CET game header/.cpp declaration, a Relic declaration CET left commented out (capped medium). Types translated to the A2 /Cataclysm header set (headers_r2b was not on disk, so tools/prep_ghidra_headers.py was re-run into a scratch dir: 1,639 decls, 298 asserts, clang rc=0; clang AST catalog of 609 typedefs + 375 tags): names present there are kept verbatim; bool->sdword (Relic TYPES.H), filehandle->smemsize, uintN_t->ubyte/udword, HW1-only enums->sdword, HW1-only function-pointer typedefs and inline function pointers->void *, HW1-only struct pointers->void *, arrays->pointers, const dropped, params named like a type get a trailing _. Checks against the binary: callee cleanup from objdump of cataclysm.exe (RET imm in the function body: 0 -> __cdecl, == HW1 arg bytes -> __stdcall, else dropped); caller cleanup (add esp,N / pop ecx right after each direct call) must equal the HW1 arg bytes at >=1 site; the r3a decompiled body: in_stack_ reads past the HW1 args, more Ghidra-found params than HW1 (for functions that never had a prototype), and per-param pointer/value/float use vs the HW1 type. Two or more independent contradictions or one strong one (count mismatch seen at >=2 sites, RET mismatch) -> dropped; one weak contradiction -> low. high = >=2 points of agreeing stack evidence and no contradiction; capped at the name's own confidence. C++ TitanInterface methods: __thiscall with an explicit void *this, references->pointers, C++ bool kept as 1-byte bool, nested enums->sdword. Body-derefs-a-scalar on a one-param function (ETG/particle setters: mov eax,[esp+4]; fld [eax]) -> the param is proposed as a pointer, capped medium. Push count before each direct call (calibrated: on 1,196 targets with consistent add esp cleanup, all-sites-push-more fired 9 times) - all >=2 sites pushing more dwords than the HW1 args -> dropped. All signatures were compiled with clang against the A2 header set (0 errors); tag-only types are written struct X. Every signature carries an explicit __cdecl/__stdcall (overrides Ghidra's misdetected __thiscall/__fastcall). Return types come from HW1; only a never-prototyped body that returns a computed value where HW1 says void is flagged (low). Per subsystem: Game-a-f: 769 proposed (high 223, low 34, medium 512), 36 dropped (body-differs 35, no-decl 1); Game-g-m: 350 proposed (high 226, low 9, medium 115), 22 dropped (body-differs 22); Game-n-s: 459 proposed (high 150, low 12, medium 297), 18 dropped (body-differs 18); Game-t-z: 162 proposed (high 75, low 9, medium 78), 24 dropped (body-differs 24); Ships: 37 proposed (high 9, low 4, medium 24), 2 dropped (body-differs 2); other: 307 proposed (high 148, low 17, medium 142), 59 dropped (body-differs 20, no-decl 36, renamed-since 1, untranslatable 2).
